notes:
Discovery lead from inbound signup (free credits). Early SMB evaluating Hosted API for customer chat widget. Primary pain: perceived latency for EU users; logs show most requests hitting us-east-1 endpoints (default) from browser clients. They are strongly cost-sensitive and using short prompt templates currently but often set max_tokens=1024 by mistake on async calls.

Key points from calls:
- 'We see the bot take too long answering customers in London — pages hang for a second or two and users bounce.' — Maya (CTO).
- Team using browser SDK with API key in proxy; no region pinning on client side.
- No dedicated SE for infra, self-serve approach so far.

Perf troubleshooting and recommendations already shared (urgent):
- Region selection: run simple curl tests to eu-west-1 vs us-east-1 endpoints; recommend moving client/proxy egress to eu-west-1 for EU traffic. Provided test URLs in follow-up email.
- Timeouts: SDK/browser proxy had axios timeout unset; recommend global request timeout 30s for streaming, 8-12s for non-streaming chat UI to fail fast and surface partial responses to UX team.
- Prompt & token guidance: advise max_tokens <= 256 for short responses; trim system messages and use slot-filling for context instead of repeating large doc dumps. Suggest dynamic truncation (LIFO of context) to keep latency predictable.
- Streaming & partial render: enable streaming (chunked responses) for UI to show tokens as they arrive — reduces perceived latency even if total completion time is same.
- Prefix caching: for repeated similar prompts (help flow), use prefix caching on customer-side; we suggested caching common KV prefixes and reusing conversation_id where appropriate.
- Retry/backoff: set client retry with exponential backoff and 500ms jitter for 429/503; avoid aggressive immediate retries that worsen latency spikes.
- Metrics to collect: RTT, TTFB, tokens per response, per-region p50/p95 latency, client->proxy egress region. Provided a Grafana panel template (link in drive doc).

Business / buying signals:
- Interested in staying on Hosted API if latency improves; will consider Dedicated only if Hosted cannot meet EU p95 under 300ms for short responses.
- Budget: small, evaluating monthly credit usage; projected $500-$1k/mo initially.
